text:
The dish looks like a small white bowl holding sliced almonds. Its diameter is roughly 15 cm at the rim, though it may be smaller. The plank it sits on is about 9 cm wide, and the bowl spans most of that width, so the bowl is probably around 10–11 cm across.

The bowl looks fairly full of flaked almonds. A bowl that size holds about 200 mL. Sliced almonds pack loosely at about 0.4 g/mL, which gives roughly 40–60 g.

Almonds are about 580 kcal per 100 g, so 50 g comes to about 290 kcal.
